dogecoin.text: @libsoftiktok Elon Musk claims Dogecoin ($DOGE) operates with full transparency, posting all actions on https://t.co/okob8DWefj and updates on X. Is this a model for financial openness, or just clever branding?

@MarioNawfal If Dogecoin is truly as transparent as Musk claims, could this push for open ledgers set a precedent for other cryptocurrencies? Would full financial transparency help or hurt the market?
